records.name: Willow Meadow
records.description: A once-flowering meadow beside your home, now dusty and quiet. Native grasses were stripped away and the pollinators left with them.
records.restorationGoal: Replant grasses and wildflowers, add water and shelter, and help 10 meadow animals return.

records.name: Old Hollow Forest
records.description: A logged-over woodland. The big trees are gone, the understory is bare, and the birds have moved on.
records.restorationGoal: Rebuild the understory, raise nesting trees and deadwood, and welcome the forest animals back.

unlock.label: Restore Willow Meadow to 60% health, welcome 10 meadow animals, and craft a Forest Restoration Kit.

records.name: Rushwater Wetland
records.description: A drained marsh. Old channels are dry, the reeds are gone, and the water that remains is murky.
records.restorationGoal: Restore shallow water, reed beds, and mud banks so wetland life can return.

unlock.label: Restore Old Hollow Forest to 80% health with 10 forest animals back, welcome 25 animals across the whole preserve, and craft a Wetland Restoration Kit.

records.name: Redstone Scrubland
records.description: An overgrazed desert flat. Without brush or burrows, the heat keeps everything away.
records.restorationGoal: Replant cactus and brush, build shade and burrows, and bring the desert back to life.

unlock.label: Restore Rushwater Wetland to 80% health with 13 wetland animals back, welcome 45 animals across the whole preserve, and craft a Scrubland Restoration Kit.

records.name: Graywind Heights
records.description: A trampled alpine slope. The wildflower turf is worn through and the talus is silent.
records.restorationGoal: Restore alpine turf, snowmelt pools, and rocky shelter for high-country animals.

unlock.label: Restore Redstone Scrubland to 80% health with 15 desert animals back, welcome 65 animals across the whole preserve, and craft an Alpine Restoration Kit.

records.name: Pelican Shore
records.description: A scoured stretch of coast where the open ocean breaks along the eastern edge. The dunes have washed out and the tidepools are empty, but sea glass, kelp, coral, and the odd pearl still wash up on the tide.
records.restorationGoal: Anchor the dunes, restore tidepools and kelp wrack, and reopen the shore to coastal life.

unlock.label: Restore Graywind Heights to 80% health with 17 alpine animals back, welcome 85 animals across the whole preserve, and craft a Migration Path Marker.
